chapter2_opening.speaker: Elder Yunjian
chapter2_opening.text:
You stand before the elder once more — qi refined, meridians opened wider than mortal flesh allows.

*"You remember my promise. The sects stir below; disciples walk in armor and scripture. Your path has led you here."*

choices.label: Do you know my past now?
I am ready to choose a sect

chapter2_memory.speaker: Elder Yunjian
chapter2_memory.text: *"Fragments only — enough to know you matter. Walk among the sects; their records may hold what I cannot."*

chapter2_sects.speaker: Elder Yunjian
chapter2_sects.text: *"Wudang, Shaolin, Mount Hua, Tang, Blood Lotus — and others hidden from the uninvited. Karma and realm decide who welcomes you."*

chapter2_sect_path.speaker: Elder Yunjian
chapter2_sect_path.text: *"Study the sects with **`/sect-list`**. When your heart settles on one, I release you to petition them."*

chapter2_righteous.speaker: Elder Yunjian
chapter2_righteous.text: *"Then let your karma stay bright on **`/adventure`**. The righteous sects will notice."*

chapter2_neutral.speaker: Elder Yunjian
chapter2_neutral.text: *"Balance is its own strength. Many sects accept neutral hearts — choose wisely."*

sect_unlock.speaker: Elder Yunjian
sect_unlock.text: *"Go. **`/sect-join`** when you find your home among the martial world. Your story continues from here."*

complete.speaker: Elder Yunjian
complete.text: *"The scroll is unwritten ahead. Walk your dao."*
